operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: retain source and private settings, export domain data, restore into fresh empty resources, run owner setup, re-export and compare before switching traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
